title: Trace engineering relationships and change impact
description: Engineers, architects, and reviewers can record and follow explicit engineering relationships, inspect architectural responsibility, and investigate possible change impact with the supporting paths and limits visible.

includes: Author authoritative typed relationships and inspect their derived inverse views.
Navigate requirement parentage and cross-domain relationships within a selected project model state.
Inspect declared allocation gaps and inconsistencies and relationship-based potential impact.
excludes: Unrecorded dependency inference, cross-project or cross-baseline traversal, and a particular visualization technology.
Engineering approval or satisfaction inferred from relationship presence.

sources.basis: IR-002 and its Scenario/SR analysis establish this bounded stakeholder capability; it remains draft analysis, not an implemented feature claim.
